action.rationale: Fresh start with dim=10 and large budget 2000 (≥ 20·dim=200) on a cheap, deterministic problem—per guidelines we should probe first. Allocate ~12% (240 evals) to diagnose structure (basins, smoothness) so we can pick and tune the main method confidently next round.

Probes indicate a smooth single basin: P5 cosine_min = 1.0 and P4 shows strong local progress (rel_gain_median = 0.98) with low endpoint_y_spread = 0.14; P3 quadratic R²_rank = 0.958 also suggests a bowl-shaped landscape. Polishing with L-BFGS-B from the incumbent (y = 5735.05) should reach the local optimum fastest on this problem.

Probes indicate a smooth single basin (P5 cosine 1.0; P4 endpoint_y_spread 0.1402; P3 quad R² 0.972), and L-BFGS-B has exhausted at y=149.15. With only 475 evaluations left, more global exploration is unlikely to help and would waste budget.
